title: Your TV may screenshot your screen twice a second #Shorts
description:
Texas says smart TVs can capture your screen "as often as every 500 milliseconds" using ACR. Samsung's agreement with Texas says it must halt ACR viewing-data collection without express consent.
On Samsung: Settings > Support > Terms & Privacy > Privacy Choices > Viewing Information Services (menus vary by brand).

Sources: Texas Attorney General (Samsung agreement, read 30 Oct 2026); TechRadar, 16 Dec 2025; Malwarebytes, Mar 2026.
